name: Dranzer
description: The blazing phoenix of balance. Dranzer builds flame heat with every passing moment — and when the heat reaches its peak, it erupts in a burst of true fire that scorches all who stand in its way.

ability.name: Dranzer Flame
ability.description: Dranzer builds flame heat each turn. Every 3 turns, it releases a Flame Burst — dealing 25 true damage to the enemy and healing 15 HP. While heat is building, Dranzer gains +10 ATK passively.

chain._note: Flame Burst: 25 true damage every 3 stacks
Flame Burst: heal 15 HP every 3 stacks

special_move.name: Flame Saber
special_move.description: Dranzer ignites its blade with phoenix fire and unleashes a three-hit blazing slash — cutting through defenses and leaving the enemy burning in its wake.
flavour_texts: 🔥 **Flame Saber** — Dranzer ignites with phoenix fire!
💥 **Strike 3** — FLAME SABER — PHOENIX INFERNO — YOU'RE BURNING!
